**Finding: compliant** (rule INSURANCE, severity low)

Section 18 of the agreement already satisfies the preferred position in full, so no redline was proposed:

- **§ 18.1** binds Copperleaf (Vendor), at its own expense, for the term plus one year: CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate; workers' compensation as required by law; employer's liability USD 1M; professional E&O USD 2M; cyber and privacy liability USD 5M.
- **§ 18.2** adds certificates of insurance and evidence of coverage on request, reputable insurers, primacy over our insurance where commercially customary, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and express confirmation that insurance does not cap Vendor's liabilities.

This clears the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) comfortably and even adds employer's liability cover we did not ask for. All obligations run against the counterparty and benefit us, so there is nothing to flag.
